title: Understand CodeCheck configuration
description: A named set of CodeCheck checks, stored in the project's codecheck/configs folder and shared with the team.

automatic.description: Run in the background after every analysis (this is what feeds the Problems panel and the Violations view).

can_baseline.description: Whether inspections with this configuration can be used as a baseline.

checks.description: The checks to run: a check ID string, or an object carrying per-check options.

severity.description: Severity override: 0 Informational, 25 Low, 50 Medium, 75 High, 100 Urgent, -1 none.

options.description: The check's option values, keyed by option ID.

excludes.description: Path prefixes this configuration's checks leave alone — third-party or generated code. A file is skipped when its project-relative path starts with one of these, e.g. "src/lib/" or "build/". Takes effect on the next analysis.

excluded_checks.description: Check IDs to drop even when a tag or parent would include them.

tags.description: Include every check carrying one of these tags.

parents.description: Include every check under one of these group paths.
